messages.body: Re-probed S4 at 4aa77558d1be809ed98acb5ea2847386ef3e9a5d: URL/email autolinks (alone and mixed with text), real tags stripped, code-span tags literal, and all round-1 claims (nested links, combining marks, empty-text omission, duplicate suffixes) hold, with 95 tests passing. The two new guards (precomposed accent, depth-filtered duplicate suffixes) and the autolink tests each fail when the behavior is mutated in a scratch copy; I found no new CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW issues, only one INFO note on custom-scheme pseudo-tags. Nothing is left, and no worktree file was modified.
